title: Document
description: One API documentation source file, as emitted by the doc-kit `json` generator. The file is the root of a tree of nodes, one per heading, in document order.

$schema.description: The URL of the schema this document conforms to. Its last path segment is the schema version.

id.description: The document's identifier: its path, slugged. Unique within a documentation set.

path.description: The document's path inside the input tree, without extension. Cross-document links target `<path>.html`.

type.description: The document's declared type: a module reference, a miscellaneous (conceptual) page, or a page of globals.

module.description: The name of the module the document describes, when it describes one.

introducedIn.description: The version the document itself was introduced in.

sourceLink.description: The implementation the document describes, when it links to one.

children.description: The document's headings, nested by depth, in document order.

Version.title: Version
Version.description: A version string as authored, such as `v18.0.0`, or a release-process placeholder such as `REPLACEME`.

SourceLink.title: SourceLink
SourceLink.description: A link to the implementation a document describes.

path.description: The implementation's path, relative to the repository root, as authored.

url.description: The implementation's URL, when a repository is configured.

index.description: The index as authored, including any sub-level, such as `1.1`.

description.description: The text following the index, as Markdown.

Change.title: Change
Change.description: One record of an entry's change history.

versions.description: The versions the change shipped in.

prUrl.description: The pull request that made the change.

commit.description: The commit that made the change, on records that predate pull requests.

Example.title: Example
Example.description: A fenced code block from an entry's body.

TypeLink.title: TypeLink
TypeLink.description: A type name inside a type's text, resolved to documentation.

name.description: The resolved name, exactly as it appears in the text.

href.description: Where the name is documented: a URL, or a link relative to the document.

start.description: The offset of the name's first character in the text.

end.description: The offset after the name's last character in the text.

text.description: The annotation as a TypeScript type expression, normalised: single-line, union members separated by ` | `.

links.description: The resolved names in the text, by offset, non-overlapping.

Parameter.title: Parameter
Parameter.description: A parameter of a signature or event, or a property of an object parameter.

name.description: The parameter's name, without any rest marker.

description.description: The parameter's description, as Markdown, without its default value.

default.description: The default value as authored, such as `'utf8'` or `false`.

optional.description: Whether the parameter may be omitted: bracketed in the signature, or documented with a default.

rest.description: Whether the parameter is a rest parameter.

properties.description: The documented properties of an object parameter, or the arguments of a callback.

description.description: The return value's description, as Markdown.

Signature.title: Signature
Signature.description: A callable's signature: the parameters declared in its heading, described by its typed list.

Entry.title: Entry
Entry.description: What every heading, the document's own included, carries: its metadata and its body.

title.description: The heading text as authored, inline Markdown included.

stability.description: The entry's stability index, when declared.

added.description: The versions the entry was added in, as authored.

deprecated.description: The versions the entry was deprecated in.

removed.description: The versions the entry was removed in.

napiVersion.description: The Node-API versions the entry is available in.

changes.description: The entry's change history, as authored.

description.description: The entry's body as Markdown: everything under the heading except its metadata, stability index, and the typed list a signature or type was taken from. Empty when the entry has no body.

summary.description: A one-paragraph plain-text summary: the entry's `llm_description` when declared, else its first paragraph.

examples.description: The fenced code blocks in the body, in order. They remain in the description too.

NodeBase.title: NodeBase
NodeBase.description: What every node below the document root carries, on top of an entry.

kind.description: What the heading documents. Decides which further properties the node has.

id.description: The heading's slug, unique within the document. It is the heading's anchor in HTML output.

name.description: The bare identifier the heading documents, or the heading's plain text for a section.

scope.description: Whether the entry is reached through its module, or available globally.

overloadOf.description: For the second and later of several sibling headings documenting one callable, the `id` of the first.

children.description: The headings nested under this one, in document order.

SectionNode.title: SectionNode
SectionNode.description: A heading that documents no API entry: prose, a deprecation, a command-line option.

ClassNode.title: ClassNode
ClassNode.description: A class. Its constructors, methods, properties and events are its children.

extends.description: The class the class extends, when documented.

StaticMethodNode.title: StaticMethodNode
StaticMethodNode.description: A static method of a class.

PropertyNode.title: PropertyNode
PropertyNode.description: A property of a module, class or object.

default.description: The property's default value as authored, when documented.

EventNode.title: EventNode
EventNode.description: An event emitted by the parent class or module.

parameters.description: The arguments passed to the event's listeners.

Node.title: Node
Node.description: A heading below the document root.
